overview.description: The Columbia Research Enhanced Mid Cap ETF (REMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through investments in US mid-cap companies. Stock selection uses a rules-based, proprietary industry-specific quantitative framework. REMC was launched on Dec 11, 2025 and is issued by Columbia Threadneedle.
